title: Universal Z-only Correction for Distributing Arbitrary Graph States in Quantum Networks
summary: Distributing arbitrary graph states across quantum networks is a central challenge for modular quantum computing and measurement-based quantum communication. I present a protocol converting |E| elementary two-qubit resource states -- one per edge of the target graph G = (V,E) -- into the distributed graph state |G>, using only operations local to each party (single-qubit gates, CZ gates between a party's own data and resource qubits, single-qubit measurements) and classical communication, and reaching arbitrary topologies, not just the GHZ class of prior walk-based schemes.
